title: Corso in post-war Italy, Knight of Malta

tellings.quote: Colonel Philip J. Corso, later famous for his claims regarding reverse engineering alien materials at the Pentagon in his book, The Day After Roswell, served as a high-ranking intelligence officer in Italy during the post-war period.

plain: An Army officer named Colonel Philip J. Corso served as a high-ranking intelligence officer in Italy after the Second World War, according to Michels, who tells it himself. Corso later became famous for his 1997 book The Day After Roswell, in which he claimed to have handled the reverse engineering, meaning taking apart to learn how to copy, of alien materials at the Pentagon. Michels brings up the Italian years as background on who Corso was before those claims.
